description: Artelys Crystal Super Grid (ACSG) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by not stated on the factsheet. Energy systems are rapidly getting more and more complex with the increasing integration of intermittent energy sources and energy markets coupling together on a large scale. Therefore, the future of energy mixes in most countries is rather uncertain. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Methodical focus: Optimization. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.

outputs: The model is able to simultaneously optimise the operations of and investments in all categories of assets, including different generation technologies, flexible consumption technologies, storage assets, cross-border interconnections and pipelines between areas. The model allows for global constraints to be introduced, such as CO2 budget or maximum output by a given technology over the year (e.g., maximum running hours of coal assets may be constrained).
